academic_records.metadata_verification: Official arXiv API and revised abstract checked 2026-10-18.

summary.en: The revised scientific-workflow audit compares twelve model configurations on twenty source-grounded choices across ten cases, separating semantic decisions, downstream calculations and final labels. Jev ties five other configurations on semantic correctness with the lowest observed median latency among successful responses. Seven wrong choices by comparison models alter downstream counts without changing the final label, showing why end-result accuracy alone is insufficient.
summary.zh: 修订后的科学工作流审计在十个案例、二十项有来源的选择中比较十二组模型配置，分别衡量语义判断、下游计算与最终标签。Jev 与其他五组配置并列达到完全语义正确，成功回答的观测中位延迟最低。对照模型的七次错误选择改变了下游计数，却未改变最终标签，说明仅看最终准确率并不足够。

academic_records.title: More Choices, Fewer Decisions: Ordinal-Scale Bias in JEV-like Direct-Decision Models
academic_records.metadata_verification: Official arXiv API and revised abstract checked 2026-10-18.

summary.en: Across forty datasets and nine decision models, this revision finds systematic underuse of ordinal rating scales. Finer scales intensify compression; candidate randomization reduces but does not remove it, and larger models improve accuracy without consistently restoring scale use. Targeted training mitigates the effect, identifying scale utilization as a reliability objective separate from headline accuracy.
summary.zh: 修订稿在四十个数据集和九个决策模型上发现系统性的序数评分尺度利用不足。更细尺度加剧压缩，随机候选顺序只能部分缓解，增大模型虽然提升准确率，却不能稳定恢复尺度使用。针对性训练可以改善这一现象，表明尺度利用率是独立于总体准确率的可靠性目标。

summary.en: SecJev adapts Kev's candidate scorer to security decisions using fourteen tasks from eight sources. The revised evaluation finds that security specialization improves every model size; at 0.8B and 4B, accuracy and latency are close to answer-only generative fine-tuning with lower peak GPU memory. Transfer experiments support specialization on the tested injection and traffic tasks, not a universal security guarantee.

academic_records.title: Prism-1: Position- and Rival-Independent Scoring for System One Models
academic_records.metadata_verification: Official arXiv API retrieved 2026-10-18; original abstract screened.
academic_records.reason: Direct Jev / typed-decision research or explicit evaluation; see bilingual reviewed summary.

summary.en: Prism-1 isolates candidate attention blocks and shares positions to enforce option-order invariance and independence from rival options. On five benchmark sets it stays close to a matched trained baseline while retaining decisions under reordering. The guarantees concern the scoring construction and choice axioms, rather than correctness or calibration of the resulting decisions.
summary.zh: Prism-1 隔离候选项注意力块并共享位置，保证选项顺序不变性与相对竞争项独立性。在五组基准上，它接近匹配训练基线，并在重排时保持决策。保证针对评分结构与选择公理，不等于所得判断一定正确或概率已校准。

summary.en: Intern-Decision scores multiple typed fields in one causal forward pass, with text and optional image inputs. Its 4B model reports 90.02% mean accuracy across seven suites versus 88.74% for Jev, while a small calibration pilot and confidence-routing study test probability use. Local GPU timings and hosted comparisons use different serving conditions.

academic_records.title: MJev-Spatial: System One Spatial Intelligence via Native Attention Matching
academic_records.metadata_verification: Official arXiv API retrieved 2026-10-18; original abstract screened.
academic_records.reason: Direct Jev / typed-decision research or explicit evaluation; see bilingual reviewed summary.

summary.en: MJev-Spatial uses native attention projections to score spatial choices, numeric bins and image regions without adding parameters. Trained on 12.3 million converted spatial question-answer pairs, it leads seven of twelve evaluated benchmarks and reports faster inference than autoregressive baselines. Numeric and point outputs use coarse-to-fine decisions, so a prediction can require several decision stages.
summary.zh: MJev-Spatial 利用原生注意力投影评分空间选项、数值区间和图像区域，不增加参数。模型使用 1,230 万条转换后的空间问答训练，在十二个基准中的七个领先，并报告相对自回归基线更快的推理。数值与点位预测采用由粗到细的决策，因此一次预测可能包含多个决策阶段。

summaries.en: WaterSheep fine-tunes ModernBERT with a decision head and question-type temperature scaling for Noul, Choice, Score, and multi-label probabilities. The [author's project documentation](https://github.com/SamratDuttaOfficial/WaterSheep) reports 77.8% in-distribution accuracy and 61.2% on held-out datasets, with ECE of 0.026 and 0.043. It is included as an open Jev-style model with a compatible API; English-only support, input truncation, and weaker rating performance limit its use. The DOI verifies preprint metadata; this summary relies on project documentation because the paper's full text was inaccessible.
